gaps.sentence: The house is ___ (sell) on Tuesday unless a buyer comes forward first.
gaps.explanation: 'Be + passive infinitive' (is to be sold) expresses an official arrangement.

gaps.sentence: Your booking ___ (confirm) by email — check your spam folder.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect passive: has been + confirmed; the confirmation exists now.

gaps.sentence: The painting is believed ___ (steal) by an organised gang.
gaps.explanation: The theft preceded the believing: is believed to have been + stolen.

gaps.sentence: She ___ (think) to be the finest violinist of her generation.
gaps.explanation: Impersonal passive: is thought to be. The thinkers are general, not stated.

gaps.sentence: Construction ___ (halt) after the discovery of Roman remains.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: was + halted. The halting authority is unnamed.

gaps.sentence: The ruins ___ (discover) by farmers digging a well in 1923.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive with a expressed agent: were discovered by farmers.

gaps.sentence: We had the whole house ___ (repaint) before the wedding.
gaps.explanation: 'Had the house repainted' — painters did it at our request. Object + past participle.

gaps.sentence: A decision ___ once all the evidence has been reviewed.
gaps.explanation: The decision cannot make itself: future passive will be + made.
